global_premortem: Reject both the one-chapter fallback and verse-by-verse atomization while retaining the exact whole-letter route.
Do not detach prayer from joy, commendation from mission rationale, report from action catalogue, exhortation from Demetrius testimony, or writing intention from peace and greetings.

Greek forms, discourse connectors, punctuation, paragraphing, variant sigla, Strong's-style tags, lemmas, morphology, roots, and translation renderings are evidence only and never automatic boundary authority.
Apply textual variants and the WEB/SBLGNT versification mismatch case by case without selecting a witness, reading, translation, punctuation, or verse-number scheme.
Do not infer identity, authorship, date, history, office, faction, mission practice, finance, ethnicity, hospitality policy, discipline policy, source/dependence, canon, doctrine, or theology.
Keep all units and routes LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus.
global_guards: Original-language evidence is evaluated in phrase, clause, syntax, discourse, epistolary, and whole-letter context; isolated roots, glosses, lemmas, morphology, and Strong's-style tags are not meaning or boundary authority.
SBLGNT punctuation and variant sigla and WEB headings, paragraphs, punctuation, Strong's-style tags, and verse numbering are evidence only.
No preferred textual witness, reading, source tradition, translation, punctuation, or versification is selected.
No identity, authorship, date, history, office, faction, mission/hospitality/discipline policy, source/dependence, canon, doctrine, or theology selection is made.
External or human review remains required at convergence; this same-model role does not count as a cross-model independent vote.
